description: A while loop counts up until its condition fails
code:
count = 0
while count < 5:
    count = count + 1
count

description: A while condition reads a live rule that each iteration updates
code:
water = 0
full = water >= 9
pours = 0
while not full:
    water = water + 4
    pours = pours + 1
assert(full, true)
pours

description: A while loop whose condition is false at the start runs no iteration
code:
queue = 0
handled = 0
while queue > 0:
    handled = handled + 1
handled

description: A method loops over its own instance and returns from inside the loop
Nested while loops create a triangle of instances
code:
class Dot(row, col):
    this.row = row
    this.col = col
row = 0
while row < 3:
    col = 0
    while col <= row:
        Dot(row, col)
        col = col + 1
    row = row + 1
Dot.length

description: A function body accumulates into a name it assigned before the while loop
code:
def total(n):
    sum = 0
    while n > 0:
        sum = sum + n
        n = n - 1
    return sum
total(4)

description: A runaway while loop raises a TypeError and rolls back its changes
code:
steps = 0
try:
    while steps != 10:
        steps = steps + 4
catch error:
    failure = error
assert(steps, 0)
failure

description: Variables named while stay ordinary beside while loops
code:
while = 2
rounds = 0
while while > 0:
    while = while - 1
    rounds = rounds + 1
[while, rounds]
